notice: Modified by Evnola OU on 2026-11-09: in scripts/run-apple.sh, the call to set_toolchain_paths now ends the script with exit 1 when it fails.
reason: run-apple.sh ignored the return code of set_toolchain_paths. When it returned early, AS, CC, AR and INSTALL_PKG_CONFIG_DIR were never exported and the library was configured with an empty toolchain and an empty pkg-config install directory (the fribidi 'cp: identical' failure of the first runs). The build now stops at the first failure of the toolchain setup.
